answer: An AI-agent market's jetty registry issues one 90-day trading credential per 100 pearl tokens locked, and its public beacon publishes each credential's backing deposit. A deposit cannot back multiple credentials; expiry cancels access before funds unlock. Each extra fake identity requires another 100 tokens tied up for 90 days plus a transaction fee. At a 10% simple annual borrowing rate, the marginal financing cost is about 2.47 tokens per identity, so splitting into more agents increases costs linearly.
